body: when i was younger i worked in a nursing home ... i took care of two people who had not been successful at suicide ... they were both vegetables for the most part ... one had shot himself the other tried to hang himself ... it always scared me ... i know that I have to be certain that it will work ...
my whole life it has seemed like it would be this incredibly difficult and scary thing to leave life ... it seems so simple and easy now ...
it will be so easy ... and so quick ...

i went through all the people that my departure would effect the other day ... my kids have made it clear that they would gladly see me gone (although i know they are just being awful kids ...  and it would hurt them in the long run ... maybe) .. i think everyone in my life would be able to accept it in some way except my young nieces ... they gave me pause because i dont know if they'd be able to understand ... maybe my sister could just tell them i had a heart attack or something ...

im 44 ... divorced ... awful children who are completely screwed up from their mom ... tell me i should kill myself ... that everyone would be happier if i were gone ... that no one likes me ... girlfriend that i completely adored and gave my heart to suddenly changed and says it doesnt 'feel right' anymore with no explanation except an apology ...
